summary.text: Tad Jude is the Republican nominee for Minnesota Secretary of State. A Maple Grove attorney and former district court judge, he served in the Minnesota House and Senate in the 1970s and 1980s and ran unsuccessfully for Congress in 2024; he is campaigning on photo ID, using the federal SAVE database for voter rolls and a vote to restore the 1983 state flag.

paragraphs.text: Jude began in elective office in the Minnesota House of Representatives, serving from 1973 to 1982.
He then served in the Minnesota Senate from 1983 to 1988, where he was elected as a DFL member.
Jude later served as a district court judge in Minnesota's 10th judicial district from January 2011 to January 2022.
In 2024 he was an unsuccessful candidate in Minnesota's 3rd congressional district.

Jude is a self-employed attorney and small-business owner who lives in Maple Grove, and in his KAXE questionnaire he described his experience as a legislator, judge, attorney and small business owner.
